usage: 尼日利亞 is used as a proper noun to refer to the country Nigeria in conversations.
When talking about nationalities or countries, you can use 尼日利亞 as a noun to specify the country.
You can combine 尼日利亞 with verbs like 去 (heoi3, to go) or 嚟 (lai4, to come) to talk about traveling to or from Nigeria.
It can also be used in questions when asking about someone's origin or nationality.
In daily speech, 尼日利亞 is often used directly without adding any classifier.
